function: Downlink channel estimation for FDD massive MIMO-OFDM: CR-DnCNN denoises the channel estimate reconstructed by OMP compressed sensing from comb pilots (p. 1, 3).
system: FDD MIMO-OFDM downlink: BS with Nt=16 antennas, Nr=8 single-antenna users, 512 subcarriers, L=160 taps, 32 comb pilots, QPSK, 28 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: OMP estimate refined by CR-DnCNN: complex convolution, three residual-assisted subnetworks (4 conv layers each); supervised offline training on the residual to true CSI, MSE loss, Adam (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Authors' MATLAB simulation of MIMO-OFDM at 28 GHz with i.i.d. CN(0,1) channel entries; 16,000 training, 4,000 validation, 4,000 test samples (p. 4).
test_conditions: Train/validation/test split of 16,000/4,000/4,000 samples from one simulation; evaluation over SNR 0-30 dB with 8, 16 and 32 pilots; retraining per pilot count not stated (p. 4).
baselines: MMSE, OMP [16], GARN [11], DnNet [13], DnCNN [17]; ReEsNet [15] in the complexity table (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR and pilot count, BER versus SNR, and computational complexity in GFlops (p. 4-5).
complexity: Training-phase order in Eq. (9), O(K Nr Nt k^2 b I (...)); Table I: 0.00502 GFlops for CR-DnCNN vs 0.00973 ReEsNet, 0.01163 DnNet, 0.04469 GARN (p. 3, 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "in our designed MIMO system transmitting OFDM" - own MATLAB simulator with i.i.d. CN(0,1) channel entries; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "training, validation, and test sets consist of 16,000, 4,000, and" - held-out part of the same simulation; Fig. 3 shows 8, 16 and 32 pilots but the paper never says a model trained at one pilot count is tested at another.
q3_support: p. 4: "among MMSE, GARN, OMP, DnCNN, DnNet" - classical MMSE and OMP versus learned GARN, DnNet and DnCNN, on NMSE (Fig. 4) and BER (Fig. 5).
q4_support: p. 5: "Table I shows the computational complexity of ReEsNet," - CR-DnCNN 0.00502 GFlops; p. 3: "computational complexity of CR-DnCNN network in the" - training-phase order, Eq. (9).
q5_support: p. 4: "training, validation, and test sets consist of 16,000, 4,000, and" - data generated by the authors in MATLAB; no code or data link and no public channel dataset.
notes: Multi-antenna BS (Nt=16), so the system check passes; channel estimation: area 2. Fig. 3 reports CR-DnCNN at Np=8, 16 and 32 pilots without saying whether one model or one model per pilot count was used, so q2 is 0 under the explicit rule; reviewer may check p. 4. Table I and Figs. 3-5 read from page images of pp. 4-5.
